title: Salmon Teriyaki Noodles
teaser: Pan-fried salmon and noodles tossed in a sticky homemade teriyaki sauce.
ingredients: Spring onion and sesame seeds to garnish
steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions and drain.
Season the salmon and pan-fry skin-side down for 4-5 minutes, then flip and cook for 2-3 minutes more. Flake into chunks.
Whisk the soy sauce, honey, vinegar, and garlic together in the pan and simmer for 1-2 minutes until slightly sticky.
Toss the noodles through the sauce, then fold in the salmon.
Drizzle with sesame oil and top with spring onion and sesame seeds.

title: Chicken Noodle Stir-Fry
teaser: Chicken and vegetables stir-fried with noodles in a simple soy sauce.
steps: Cook the noodles according to packet instructions, drain, and set aside.
Stir-fry the chicken in a hot wok until cooked through, then set aside.
Add the pepper and carrot and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes.
Add the garlic, then return the chicken and noodles to the pan with the soy sauce and sesame oil.
Toss everything together for 1-2 minutes and serve.
